recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-37455 decision for current core build and publication surfaces without reopening the separate R6 decision that moved GraphDefinition's authoritative source out of core; any broader GraphDefinition ModelInfo cleanup should use a separate issue trail.
issue_request: FHIR-37455 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 change request asking to add title to GraphDefinition and CompartmentDefinition, with a 14-0-0 vote and resolution saying these title elements were editorially useful even though not required by the CanonicalResource pattern.
initial_application: Commit 90d07939a987bed043576d57ff8c79993c06d6e7 added CompartmentDefinition.title and GraphDefinition.title to their StructureDefinitions, but left CompartmentDefinition.title with copied CapabilityStatement definition text and did not update the active FHIR ModelInfo Library sidecar.
additional_context: CompartmentDefinition remains active in source/fhir.ini. GraphDefinition's authoritative StructureDefinition source was removed from core by 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd and the conformance module now points readers to the API Incubator, but the active FHIR ModelInfo Library still retained CompartmentDefinition and GraphDefinition model entries without title. FHIR-I minutes confirm the persuasive motion, and no conflicting community discussion was found.
reconciliation: Corrected CompartmentDefinition.title so its definition refers to a compartment definition, added title elements to the FHIR ModelInfo class entries for CompartmentDefinition and the retained GraphDefinition model entry, and refreshed the embedded Library/FHIR-ModelInfo payload.
source_changes: source/compartmentdefinition/structuredefinition-CompartmentDefinition.xml: corrected CompartmentDefinition.title definition text from capability statement to compartment definition.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: added title to CompartmentDefinition and GraphDefinition class entries in the FHIR ModelInfo sidecar.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: refreshed the embedded base64 payload to match the ModelInfo content file.
